description: The same compliance topic across several US states, for deciding where to incorporate or for an organization that operates in more than one state. Each state's records carry their own citation and verification status; a record marked review_required is unsettled and must not be presented as a settled rule. Accepts up to eight states.

states.description: State names or two-letter abbreviations. Up to eight.

topic.description: The topic to compare, for example 'solicitation', 'reporting', 'formation', 'tax'.

name: compare_states
